notes:
What's new in 1.3.5:
- Adds Light, Dark, and System appearance modes in Tools > Settings. Light preserves the existing LogLens look, Dark adds a softer charcoal UI, and System follows Windows when available.
- Updates the in-app User Guide window and guide content so the contents pane and documentation match the selected appearance mode.
- Expands built-in Supplies and Procurement search fields to Flexible Field 1 through Flexible Field 100.
- Lets Enter run a search from any Search Parameters field.
- Adds main-tab keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+Tab, and Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+4.
- Adds a Settings option for which tab opens after connecting from the Connections tab.
